beats.care: Lots of first-time investors applied. If you did, don't panic or celebrate on listing day alone. Think long term.
beats.what: Jio's IPO got over 1 crore applications, beating Waaree Energies' 97 lakh, and was bid more than 20.5 times.
beats.why: It was fully subscribed in 100 minutes. Big institutions bid about 15 times their quota, and retail investors over 2 times.

cards.body: A global first, says the report.
cards.caption: Applications for Jio Platforms' IPO

cards.body: Most bids came at the top of the price band, ₹1,119 a share. Total demand topped $15 billion.
Big funds usually wait till the last day. Here they bid 10 times over by day two.

hook: Jio IPO becomes the *first in the world* to get 1 crore applications

learn.t: An IPO (initial public offering) is when a company sells shares to the public for the first time.

tldr: Jio Platforms' ₹30,213 crore IPO closed with over 1 crore applications and bids worth more than ₹7 lakh crore.
